# React Native Developer — Tidewell (fictional)

Tidewell makes a budgeting app for students. London, on-site five days a week.

## Responsibilities

- Build new features for our mobile app.
- Release through Fastlane and monitor crashes with Sentry.

## Requirements

- 3+ years of React Native.
- TypeScript.
- Redux Toolkit or Zustand for state management.
- Experience publishing mobile apps to app stores.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

## Nice to have

- Native modules in Swift or Kotlin.
- Experience with fintech products.

Candidates must already live in the UK; we cannot sponsor visas or relocation.
